script_text: Stop! Scorpio, the stars are screaming at you right now. Pluto, your modern ruling planet, is retrograding through your 4th House of home and forming a tense square to Mars, your traditional ruler, in Pisces in your 5th House of passion, stirring the deep Water element within. Meanwhile the Sun in Cancer trines that Mars, flooding your 9th House of philosophy with intuitive fire while the Moon in Virgo sharpens your 11th House networks. If single, this magnetic alignment draws a soulful Pisces who matches your intensity; if taken, guard against silent power plays around bedtime that threaten trust. In your 10th House of career, Venus in Leo bestows a golden opportunity—pitch your boldest idea to leadership before noon to secure financial gain. An unexpected blessing arrives: a forgotten invoice paid triples your weekend budget and restores peace. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
